title: Chargeback Fee Computation Standard for the Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
Computation of the chargeback fee on a Pocketwire Business Profile.

**The chargeback priced.** The chargeback priced is the chargeback most recently debited on the profile, and its buyer claim is the claim opened on the same sale. The claim's opened date is the date recorded when that claim opened; the seller's response date is the date of the most recent seller response recorded on that claim.

**The fee.** The chargeback fee is the claim-size chargeback fee less the personal plan chargeback reduction and less the seller response credit, never below zero, and rounded to the nearest cent.

**Plain case.** Charged in full on the chargeback at the tier's chargeback fee, with no surcharge, scaling or reduction, the fee is the tier's chargeback fee, kept to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Claim-size chargeback fee | Personal plan reduction | Seller response credit | Chargeback fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 30.00 | USD 2.50 | USD 5.00 | USD 22.50 |
| USD 30.00 | none | none | USD 30.00 |
| USD 4.00 | USD 2.50 | USD 5.00 | USD 0.00 (never below zero) |

**Which chargeback (hypothetical ledger).** A profile has chargebacks debited on 2 March and 9 April: the chargeback priced is the one of 9 April, and its claim is the claim opened on the sale that chargeback was taken on.
